subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Which part of this broad architecture request should OpenClaw core own first: generic bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58398, or a plugin/API seam for observation extraction?
rationale: Current main partially addresses AGENTS.md bootstrap relevance and has plugin/context-engine compaction surfaces, but choosing a generic relevance algorithm or moving observation extraction into core requires maintainer product and ownership intent.

options.title: Split Into Focused Trackers
options.body: Create or confirm separate focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then repurpose or close this umbrella after links are in place.

options.title: Keep As Architecture Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue only as a parent discussion and keep automated repair disabled until maintainers prioritize one track.

options.title: Supersede After Relinking
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers confirm bootstrap and compaction are fully covered by narrower open items and observation extraction belongs outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Focused Trackers
recommendation.body: Create or confirm separate focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then repurpose or close this umbrella after links are in place.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already supplied the prior review on this exact issue and has the strongest combined signal across bootstrap/runtime history and scoping discussion.
